es.title: Manlab
es.subtitle: Doctor-Prescribed Hair Regrowth Platform
es.problem: En salud personal se compra por confianza: la gente duda de tratamientos que no entiende y de sitios que parecen una tienda cualquiera.
es.solution: Sitio moderno y accesible que explica la ciencia detrás del tratamiento, guía una evaluación gratuita personalizada y transmite rigor médico.

en.title: Manlab
en.subtitle: Doctor-Prescribed Hair Regrowth Platform
en.problem: In personal health people buy on trust: they hesitate over treatments they do not understand and sites that look like any other store.
en.solution: A modern, accessible site that explains the science behind the treatment, guides a personalized free assessment and conveys medical rigor.
